suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update e2e-infra-worker SKILL.md to instruct workers to use e2e/fixtures/helpers.ts for getAvailablePort, terminateProcessTree, and killProcessesOnPort instead of importing from @glade/shared. Playwright's Node.js runtime cannot resolve bun workspace packages.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Both setup-test-fixtures and setup-smoke-test-and-isolation workers discovered this and deviated from the skill. The SKILL.md still references @glade/shared/net and @glade/shared/process imports.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update e2e-infra-worker SKILL.md to document the R process orphan cleanup pattern: killProcessesOnPort() must be called during server teardown because the Bun server's R child process survives parent termination.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: setup-smoke-test-and-isolation worker added killProcessesOnPort() as a deviation. setup-test-fixtures also needed this pattern. This is a consistent gap in the skill.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update e2e-infra-worker SKILL.md to document that bg_use_default_workflow() requires a bg_handle object from bg_init() and both must be chained in a single Rscript -e invocation.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: setup-smoke-test-and-isolation worker discovered this through trial and error. The skill doesn't mention this API constraint.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add a convention: compiled Stan model binaries (non-.stan files in e2e/fixtures/models/) should be gitignored. Build artifacts should never be committed.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: A 2.7MB compiled Stan binary (e2e/fixtures/models/eight_schools) was committed to git by a worker. No existing .gitignore rule prevents this.
